result.summary: Found 2 layout issues: truncated restaurant names in the Fastest near you carousel and a clipped pizza card at the bottom of Popular right now.

issues.description: The third restaurant name in Fastest near you is cut off mid-word as 'Trattoria Piccol', so the full title is unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Allow card titles to wrap to two lines, use a smaller font, or ensure horizontal scroll/card width fully reveals the name.

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card under Popular right now shows only the image with no name, rating, delivery info, or other metadata visible below it.
issues.suggestion: Ensure each restaurant card in the list has adequate vertical space so the full title and details render below the image.
